metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Fix Neck and Upper Back Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly fix neck and upper back pain.

A major cause of neck and upper back pain is due to weakness and tightness in the muscles that support this area. This includes the rhomboids and upper trapezius. 

To fix this, the video will be broken up into two parts, focusing on stretching and strengthening for both quick and long-lasting relief.

To get the best results, go through all exercises and use what gives you the most relief.

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give quick neck and upper back pain relief... even in as little as 30 seconds. 

Watch now and get rid of neck and upper back pain!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:46 Seated Twist (Stretch)
3:09 Hook & Pull (Stretch)
5:09 YUW (Stretch)
7:15 Wall Angels (Strengthening)
8:57 Shoulder Blade Pump (Strengthening)
